# Data Augmentation

## The algorithms Used

### Oclusion

![Occlusion image](occlusion.png)

Oclussion is the process of cropping/eliminating parts of an image for detection purposes. In this case using a random fraction of the image and turning that segment into

- Hyperparams:
  1. Width range (0.1, 0.3)
  2. Height range (0.2, 0.6)

### Color Jitter

![Color jitter image](https://www.google.com/imgres?q=color%20jitter%20image%20processing&imgurl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.researchgate.net%2Fpublication%2F352437017%2Ffigure%2Ffig1%2FAS%3A1035184203898880%401623818555491%2FEffects-of-Using-Color-jitter-vs-Gray-scale.png&imgrefurl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.researchgate.net%2Ffigure%2FEffects-of-Using-Color-jitter-vs-Gray-scale_fig1_352437017&docid=e8kpVZxxT1iAtM&tbnid=caOfUZkeGXpvlM&vet=12ahUKEwjyp7veicmTAxVzLTQIHVZ8GiwQnPAOegQIHBAB..i&w=532&h=272&hcb=2&ved=2ahUKEwjyp7veicmTAxVzLTQIHVZ8GiwQnPAOegQIHBAB)

Color jitter is the process of adding random color dithering into the image

- Hyperparams:
  1. Brightness range (0,1)
  2. Contrast range (0,1)
  3. Color range (0,1)

### Perspective Warp

![Perspective warp image](data:image/png;base64,)

Perspective warp is the process of scaling some factors of the image such that it can tilt or look as if you're viewing the image from another angle.

- Hyperparams:
  1. Change scale range (0, 0.15)

### Elastic distortion

![elastic distortion image](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Elastic distortion is the process of breaking an image down into segments and then warped smoothly to create a wavy structure.

- Hyperparams:
  1. alpha=0.1
